summary: Iteration 27 — Mobile navbar/overflow, desktop navbar regression, 4 new admin tabs (Customers/Disputes/Messages/Activity), Finance enhancements (pending payout + procurement dues), and Dealer Profile page. Backend: 14/14 pytest PASS (all READ endpoints 200; WRITE endpoints return graceful 503 as expected). Frontend: mobile + desktop nav fully correct, no horizontal overflow on /, /search, /printers, /papers, /contact; all 14 admin tabs render; customers table+drawer, messages list (45 cards) + filters + reply dialog, disputes/activity migration warnings, finance pending-payout column + dues empty state, orders flag button — ALL OK. Two real defects on the dealer profile feature.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing 'View Full Profile' button on each dealer row. Review request requires data-testid="dealer-view-profile-{id}" on every row, but DealersTab.jsx renders only dealer-row-{id}, dealer-seller-id-{id}, dealer-suspend-{id}. There is no link/button anywhere in the admin UI that navigates to /admin/dealers/:id. Users can only reach the page via direct URL.

Page is stuck on infinite loading spinner. The TopHeader and Footer render, but the middle area only shows Loader2 spinner and never renders the dealer-profile-page wrapper or any of the section-* blocks (business/account/bank/documents/agreement/orders/notes, profile-seller-id). Backend GET /api/admin/suppliers/{id}/detail returns 200 in pytest, so the issue is in the React component — likely the useEffect resolves but `data` is somehow falsy or shape mismatch keeps it null after .finally(setLoading(false)). Reproduced by direct-navigating to /admin/dealers/f78f4ab3-9233-4e9c-be41-2267d6250f20 (DET dealer) after admin login; spinner persists 5+ seconds with no toast.

issues: 'Set your location' coachmark popover still overlays the top-nav area on every page load — pre-existing from iteration 25/26.

action_items: Add the 'View Full Profile' button (data-testid="dealer-view-profile-{id}") in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/DealersTab.jsx — should navigate to `/admin/dealers/${d.id}`. Suggest placing it next to the existing suspend button on each row.

Debug /app/frontend/src/pages/DealerProfile.jsx — the API GET /admin/suppliers/{id}/detail returns 200 (confirmed in pytest) but the page never exits its loading state. Likely the response shape `data` (vs `data.supplier`) handling — check that the api.get destructuring `({ data })` correctly matches the FastAPI response. If the response IS `{ supplier:..., documents:..., agreements:..., orders:..., stats:... }`, the code should work; verify the actual response payload and that setData(data) is actually being called (add a console.log or check network tab). It's also possible the toast.error fires silently. Currently no toast was visible to the user.
(Optional, carry-over) Auto-dismiss the 'Set your location' coachmark.
critical_code_review_comments: DealersTab.jsx does not implement the dealer-view-profile-{id} button promised in the review request — entry point to the new DealerProfile page is missing from the UI.

DealerProfile.jsx loading-state path has no visible error fallback: if api.get throws, only a sonner toast fires and `data` stays null, falling through to the 'Dealer not found.' branch. But here the page is stuck on the spinner (loading=true) — suggests the promise never resolves OR resolves with unexpected shape. Recommend adding a console.error in catch and a timeout guard.
server.py is still 4600+ lines (carry-over) — recommend splitting into routers.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — nav/overflow/4 new tabs/finance all OK; dealer profile feature broken (page + missing entry button)

rca of the issue: Defect 1 (View Full Profile button missing): grep -rn 'view-profile' /app/frontend/src/ returns zero matches in DealersTab.jsx. Only /app/frontend/src/App.js:151 (the route) references /admin/dealers/. Main agent simply did not wire a navigation button in the table. Fix: add <Link to={`/admin/dealers/${d.id}`} data-testid={`dealer-view-profile-${d.id}`}>View Full Profile</Link> (or a Button with onClick navigate) inside the dealer row actions column. Defect 2 (DealerProfile spinner): Page loads (TopHeader + Footer render) but JSX returns the early `if (loading)` branch indefinitely. Backend endpoint /admin/suppliers/{id}/detail returns 200 in pytest, so root cause is on the frontend — likely (a) api.get response shape mismatch causing JS exception during destructuring `({ data })` from axios, or (b) toast.error fires once but `setLoading(false)` is reached in .finally so spinner should have stopped... unless the promise is genuinely pending. Recommend: temporarily add console.log inside .then/.catch/.finally and check browser DevTools network for the actual XHR. Possible auth header issue specific to this route — confirm api client attaches the Supabase token when navigating directly (not from within /admin).
